# brain-server

> Self-hosted AI agent memory: one Rust binary, one SQLite file. Human-gated
> writes, deterministic hybrid recall (vector + full-text + graph), zero
> tokens per query, local embeddings, MCP + UMP 1.0 L3, hash-chained audit,
> GDPR DSAR erasure with certificates. Runs offline on a Raspberry Pi.

Audience paths: use it (L1), run it (L2), build on it (builder), verify it (L3).

## Course

- [The course index](course/README.md): tracks for every audience, with time estimates
- [AI memory FAQ](course/faq.md): straight answers, each checkable live
- [L1: working on the system](course/l1-operator/README.md): reviewers and daily users
- [L2: running the system](course/l2-operations/README.md): install, operate, recover
- [Builder track: memory for your AI agent](course/lb-builder/README.md): API, UMP, MCP, the reference plugin
- [L3: verifying the system](course/l3-verification/README.md): check-first, reproduce script, evidence packs
